skill: Determine matrix dimensions by counting rows then columns, independently of entry values and matrix name.
reasoning_steps: Read the rectangular array and count rows.
Report the ordered pair rows × columns using radio selection or two numeric blanks.
invariants: One explicitly displayed rectangular matrix; dimensions positive; all rows equal width.
No entry arithmetic, matrix operations, or route modeling is required.
Easy workload includes arrays through 6×6, integers, radicals and a fraction as inert entries.
permitted_variations: Rows and columns may vary independently, including rectangular, square, row and column vectors supported in lesson.
Matrix labels, entry values/types and zero placement are incidental.
Radio correct position and dimension bank alternatives may vary while retaining one correct ordered pair.
Blank prompts need not remain square: the lesson explicitly permits unequal counts.

tutorial 06286713-0de9-5c18-959f-04de81bee510: square matrices have equal row and column counts.
